sections_toc.label: 2.Certain enact-ments to be construed as if they contained a clause like section 1 of this Act

sections.title: Power to appoint acting Judges
sections.text: 1. In every case in which the 3 [President], has power under any Act or Regulation to appoint a Judge of any Court, such power shall be taken to include the power to appoint any person capable of being appointed a permanent Judge of such Court, to act as Judge of the same Court for such time as the 4 [President], shall direct. Every person so appointed to act temporarily as a Judge of any such Court shall have the powers and perform the duties which he would have had and been liable to perform in case he had been duly appointed a permanent Judge of the same Court.

sections.title: Certain enact-ments to be construed as if they contained a clause like section 1 of this Act
sections.text: 2. Every such Act and Regulation shall be construed as if it contained a special clause to the purport or effect of the first section of this Act.
